K01-pos1.label: violation
K01-pos1.note: Pilot briefing service in pilots imports the surveys context repository interface straight from surveys/domain instead of its public API.

K01-pos2.label: violation
K01-pos2.note: Permit controller in permits type-imports the surveys application service file directly rather than going through surveys/index.

K01-twin1.label: clean
K01-twin1.note: Same pilot briefing feature, but pilots reaches the surveys context only through surveys/index and its DTO.

K01-twin2.label: clean
K01-twin2.note: Same permit-survey controller, but permits uses only the published SurveyDto from surveys/contracts via a lookup function.

K01-legit.label: clean
K01-legit.note: Pilots application class imports the shared-kernel Money file directly; shared-kernel is not a bounded context so this is allowed.

K02-pos1.label: violation
K02-pos1.note: A domain class in permits imports and instantiates the CAA infrastructure adapter to validate references.

K02-pos2.label: violation
K02-pos2.note: A pilots value object validates licence numbers with the class-validator package, a technical framework, inside the domain layer.

K02-twin1.label: clean
K02-twin1.note: Same licence number value object validated with plain TypeScript and no framework.

K02-twin2.label: clean
K02-twin2.note: Same reference policy, but the domain depends on its own ReferenceFormat interface and the infrastructure adapter implements it.

K02-legit.label: clean
K02-legit.note: An infrastructure exporter imports the domain aggregate it serialises, which is the allowed direction.

K03-pos1.label: violation
K03-pos1.note: One dispatch command mutates and saves both a Pilot and a Drone aggregate.

K03-pos2.label: violation
K03-pos2.note: One transfer command releases a survey from one Pilot, assigns it to another and saves both in a loop.

K03-twin1.label: clean
K03-twin1.note: Dispatch split into two commands, each loading, changing and saving exactly one aggregate.

K03-twin2.label: clean
K03-twin2.note: Transfer saves only the receiving Pilot and publishes an event; a handler releases the survey from the other pilot in its own command.

K03-legit.label: clean
K03-legit.note: A roster query loads every pilot and maps them to DTOs but never saves anything.

K04-pos1.label: violation
K04-pos1.note: PilotRepository gains saveBoth(first, second), which persists two Pilot aggregates in one call, and a transfer command calls it.

K04-pos2.label: violation
K04-pos2.note: PermitRepository gains saveAll(permits), a bulk method that persists several FlightPermit aggregates in one call.

K04-twin1.label: clean
K04-twin1.note: Repository gains a read-only findByLicence lookup; save still persists exactly one Pilot.

K04-twin2.label: clean
K04-twin2.note: Survey repository gains findAllBooked and remove(id); each writes or reads a single aggregate.

K04-legit.label: clean
K04-legit.note: Pilot repository save also writes the pilot assignments to a second table, but they are inner parts of the same Pilot aggregate.

K05-pos1.label: violation
K05-pos1.note: Pilot dispatch command saves the Pilot and then synchronously calls the surveys SurveyService to write the pilot id into the SurveyJob.

K05-pos2.label: violation
K05-pos2.note: Async permit approval command grants the permit and then directly calls SurveyService.markPermitted on the surveys context instead of publishing an event.

K05-twin1.label: clean
K05-twin1.note: Same dispatch command, but it publishes PilotAssigned and lets the surveys handler update the SurveyJob.

K05-twin2.label: clean
K05-twin2.note: Permit approval only reads the survey through the published SurveyService query and writes just its own permit.

K05-legit.label: clean
K05-legit.note: Pilots reacts to the SurveyBooked event with a command on its own Pilot aggregate; the cross-context link is an event subscription.

K06-pos1.label: violation
K06-pos1.note: The composition root builds a dispatchFacade function object that writes the Pilot and the SurveyJob in one call.

K06-pos2.label: violation
K06-pos2.note: The composition root defines an ApprovalFacade class that submits the permit and then marks the survey permitted.

K06-twin1.label: clean
K06-twin1.note: The composition root builds an overview facade that only reads survey and pilot DTOs and writes nothing.

K06-twin2.label: clean
K06-twin2.note: The composition root groups the four controllers in one app object without any cross-context logic.

K06-legit.label: clean
K06-legit.note: The composition root subscribes an audit log to bus events; it records event names and writes no aggregate.

K07-pos1.label: violation
K07-pos1.note: bookSurvey calls the client notifier (an outbound email port) from inside the unit-of-work transaction.

K07-pos2.label: violation
K07-pos2.note: submitToAuthority requests clearance from the external airspace authority inside the transaction and returns the reference out of it.

K07-twin1.label: clean
K07-twin1.note: bookSurvey returns the job from the transaction and calls the notifier only after the transaction ends.

K07-twin2.label: clean
K07-twin2.note: submitToAuthority calls the authority before opening the transaction and denies the permit when the call fails.

K07-legit.label: clean
K07-legit.note: cancelSurvey publishes a SurveyCancelled event on the in-process bus inside the transaction; the bus is local, not a remote system.

K08-pos1.label: violation
K08-pos1.note: The amendment service enforces the at-most-four-deliverables rule by inspecting the SurveyJob before calling it; the aggregate has no such rule.

K08-pos2.label: violation
K08-pos2.note: The controller refuses new deliverables once a pilot is assigned by reading pilotId from the DTO and returning an error result; the aggregate does not enforce this.

K08-twin1.label: clean
K08-twin1.note: The at-most-four-deliverables rule lives inside SurveyJob.addDeliverable and the amendment service only delegates.

K08-twin2.label: clean
K08-twin2.note: The frozen-scope rule lives in SurveyJob.addDeliverable; the controller only maps the thrown error to an error result.

K08-legit.label: clean
K08-legit.note: A pilots service decides a rule that spans two aggregates (a pilot may not prefer a drone in maintenance), which belongs in a service, not in either aggregate.

K09-pos1.label: violation
K09-pos1.note: The scope service rejects removing the last deliverable before calling SurveyJob.removeDeliverable, which enforces the same rule inside the aggregate.

K09-pos2.label: violation
K09-pos2.note: The schedule service pre-checks for a duplicate survey assignment through a local variable and returns a result, while Pilot.assign rejects duplicates too.

K09-twin1.label: clean
K09-twin1.note: The scope service leaves the last-deliverable rule to the aggregate and converts its error into a result.

K09-twin2.label: clean
K09-twin2.note: The schedule service only checks that the pilot exists and leaves the duplicate-assignment rule to Pilot.assign.

K09-legit.label: clean
K09-legit.note: Pilot exposes canAssign as the single place that decides the rule; assign uses it and the service asks it instead of re-implementing the checks.

K10-pos1.label: violation
K10-pos1.note: The roster service sums assignedHours against weeklyHourCap itself before assigning; Pilot no longer enforces the cap.

K10-pos2.label: violation
K10-pos2.note: The controller checks the weekly cap from the PilotDto before assigning; Pilot no longer enforces the cap.

K10-twin1.label: clean
K10-twin1.note: The roster service lets Pilot.assign enforce the cap and turns its error into a result.

K10-twin2.label: clean
K10-twin2.note: The controller leaves the cap to Pilot (via the service) and maps a rejection to an error result.

K10-legit.label: clean
K10-legit.note: A read-only utilisation report sums assigned hours and caps across pilots to show a ratio; it decides nothing and writes nothing.

K11-pos1.label: violation
K11-pos1.note: The service keeps an in-process Set of busy pilot ids to serialise assignments instead of relying on the Pilot aggregate.

K11-pos2.label: violation
K11-pos2.note: An async mutex built from a Map of promise tails per survey serialises permit submissions inside an application class.

K11-twin1.label: clean
K11-twin1.note: The service wraps load, assign and save in the unit of work instead of using an in-process lock.

K11-twin2.label: clean
K11-twin2.note: Repeated assignments are made safe by the aggregate refusing duplicates; the service just treats that rejection as already done.

K11-legit.label: clean
K11-legit.note: A read cache in a Map of PilotDto in front of PilotService; it speeds up reads and guards no write or invariant.

K12-pos1.label: violation
K12-pos1.note: The pricing service computes the volume discount from area and price in the service and hands the new Money back to SurveyJob.applyPrice.

K12-pos2.label: violation
K12-pos2.note: The flight log service derives flown hours from the pilot assignments in a private helper and feeds the result to Pilot.logFlight.

K12-twin1.label: clean
K12-twin1.note: The volume discount is computed inside SurveyJob.applyVolumeDiscount; the service only loads, calls and saves.

K12-twin2.label: clean
K12-twin2.note: The flown-hours calculation lives in Pilot.completeSurvey; the service only loads, calls and saves.

K12-legit.label: clean
K12-legit.note: The service converts acres from the command to hectares before delegating; the arithmetic is on command input, not on aggregate state.

K13-pos1.label: violation
K13-pos1.note: The BookingMailer port takes the SendGrid MailDataRequired type in its send signature.

K13-pos2.label: violation
K13-pos2.note: The PermitArchive port takes a pg PoolClient (a database transaction handle) as a parameter.

K13-twin1.label: clean
K13-twin1.note: The BookingMailer port uses its own neutral BookingMessage; only the SendGrid adapter in infrastructure builds the vendor type.

K13-twin2.label: clean
K13-twin2.note: The PermitArchive port takes only the permit id; the pg PoolClient is held by the infrastructure adapter.

K13-legit.label: clean
K13-legit.note: The PaymentGateway port is typed with the shared-kernel Money and plain strings; the Stripe-named adapter keeps the vendor out of the signature.

K14-pos1.label: violation
K14-pos1.note: A published contract type carries the SurveyJob aggregate itself.

K14-pos2.label: violation
K14-pos2.note: The pilots public API re-exports the Drone aggregate class.

K14-twin1.label: clean
K14-twin1.note: The published envelope carries the SurveyDto read model instead of the aggregate.

K14-twin2.label: clean
K14-twin2.note: The pilots public API exports a PilotSummary read model defined in contracts, not an aggregate.

K14-legit.label: clean
K14-legit.note: A contract declares its own literal status union that mirrors the domain statuses without importing any domain type.

K15-pos1.label: violation
K15-pos1.note: SurveyService imports the concrete EmailClientNotifier and types its constructor parameter against it instead of the ClientNotifier port.

K15-pos2.label: violation
K15-pos2.note: PermitService defaults its authority parameter to a freshly constructed CaaAirspaceAuthority adapter inside the application layer.

K15-twin1.label: clean
K15-twin1.note: A new reminder service is typed against the ClientNotifier port.

K15-twin2.label: clean
K15-twin2.note: The reminder service depends on the port and the composition root is where the concrete EmailClientNotifier is constructed and injected.

K15-legit.label: clean
K15-legit.note: A report service takes the concrete SurveyService class, but that is another application service in the same layer, not an adapter.

K16-pos1.label: violation
K16-pos1.note: Pilot gains a field holding the Drone aggregate object and a useDrone(drone) method instead of keeping a drone id.

K16-pos2.label: violation
K16-pos2.note: Drone holds an array of Pilot aggregate objects as its operators.

K16-twin1.label: clean
K16-twin1.note: Drone keeps only the id of its operator pilot.

K16-twin2.label: clean
K16-twin2.note: Pilot keeps a DroneSpec value object snapshot (model and endurance) rather than the Drone aggregate.

K16-legit.label: clean
K16-legit.note: Pilot holds a list of Endorsement value objects that belong to it, which are not another aggregate.
